spans.s: Enjoyed, used; भोगा न भुक्ता वयमेव भुक्ताः
; न तद् भुक्तं न तत् पीतं न तत् सुप्तं न तद्गतम् Udb.
क्तम् The act of eating or enjoying.
The place where any one has eaten. -Comp. -उच्छिष्टम्, -शेषः, -समुज्झितम् remnants of the food eaten, leavings of food, orts. -पीत a. one who has eaten and drunk. -भोग a.
one who has enjoyed or suffered (anything).
that which has been used, enjoyed, or employed. -मात्रे ind. immediately on having eaten;
. -वृद्धिः f. the swelling of food (in the stomach). -सुप्त a. sleeping after a meal.
Eating, enjoyment; भुक्तिं मुक्तिं च विन्दति Rāmarakṣā
(In law) Possession, fruition; प्रमाणं लिखितं भुक्तिः साक्षिणश्चेति कीर्तितम्
The daily motion of a planet.
A limit. -Comp. -पात्रम् a food-dish. -प्रदः a kind of plant (मुद्ग). -वर्जित a. not allowed to be enjoyed.
